html: XXVIII-XXXIII. Further Journey to the East.

segs.html: And thence I went towards the east, into the midst of the mountain range of the desert, and I saw a wilderness and it was solitary, full of trees and plants.
And water gushed forth from above.
Rushing like a copious watercourse [which flowed] towards the north-west it caused clouds and dew to ascend on every side.
